Association de la Jeunesse Auxerroise, commonly known as AJ Auxerre or by the abbreviation AJA, is a professional football club based in Auxerre, Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, France. The club currently competes in Ligue 1, the top division of French football. Auxerre plays its home matches at the Stade de l'Abbé-Deschamps, on the banks of the Yonne River. The team is managed by Will Still.
